items.source:
If configuring an object of this class in a Spring IoC container,
use constructor injection.
items.translation: 如果在 Spring IoC 容器中配置此类的对象，请使用构造器注入。

items.source:
This TargetSource is serializable if the target is at the time
of serialization.
items.translation: 如果目标在序列化时是可序列化的，则该 TargetSource 也是可序列化的。

items.source: The returned type should usually be constant across all target objects.
items.translation: 返回的类型通常应在所有目标对象中保持一致。

items.source: Description copied from interface: TargetSource
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：TargetSource

items.source: Create a new HotSwappableTargetSource with the given initial target object.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 HotSwappableTargetSource，使用给定的初始目标对象。

items.source: Two HotSwappableTargetSources are equal if the current target objects are equal.
items.translation: 两个 HotSwappableTargetSource 相等，当且仅当其当前目标对象相等。

items.source: Swap the target, returning the old target object.
items.translation: 交换目标，返回旧的目标对象。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the new target is invalid
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果新目标无效

items.source: initialTarget - the initial target object
items.translation: initialTarget - 初始目标对象

items.source: newTarget - the new target object
items.translation: newTarget - 新的目标对象

items.source: the old target object
items.translation: 旧目标对象

items.source: Return a target instance.
items.translation: 返回目标实例。

items.source: Return the type of the current target object.
items.translation: 返回当前目标对象的类型。

items.source:
Return a target instance. Invoked immediately before the
AOP framework calls the "target" of an AOP method invocation.
items.translation: 返回目标实例。在 AOP 框架调用 AOP 方法调用的“目标”之前立即被调用。
